endpoints.description: This endpoint always throws a RuntimeException with the message 'Simulated thrown exception'. It is used to simulate a server error.

endpoints.summary: Returns a FooDto with a null boolean field and a 201 status code
endpoints.description: Returns a FooDto object with i=42, s='FOO', and b=null. The response status is set to 201 (Created) instead of the typical 200 (OK). The null value for the boolean field b may cause issues if the client expects a non-null boolean.

endpoints.summary: Creates a resource but returns a Location header pointing to a non-existent URI
endpoints.description: Accepts a FooDto in the request body but does not validate any constraints. It returns a 201 Created response with a Location header set to '/api/doesNotExist', which does not correspond to any existing endpoint, leading to a 404 if followed.

endpoints.summary: Deletes a resource but does nothing
endpoints.description: This endpoint is supposed to delete a resource but performs no action. Consequently, a subsequent GET request to the same path would still return data, indicating that the deletion is not effective.

endpoints.summary: Partially updates the stored FooDto object
endpoints.description: Updates the internal FooDto object 'k' with non-null fields from the request body. This is a partial update, which may not be idempotent if the client expects a full replacement. The correct behavior would be to replace the entire object.
Returns the current state of the internal FooDto object 'k' with a 200 OK status. The object may have been partially updated by previous PUT requests.

endpoints.summary: Returns the current value of the integer z
endpoints.description: Returns the integer variable z, which is initially 0 and can be modified by PUT requests to /api/z.

endpoints.summary: Increments the integer z by a delta value
endpoints.description: Adds the provided delta to the integer z. This operation is not idempotent because multiple identical requests will result in different final values of z.
